metas.name: Lion
metas.description: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

metas.name: Lord of the Flies
metas.description: After a plane crash, a group of schoolboys find themselves stranded on a tropical island without adults. Ralph is elected leader and, with the help of the intelligent Piggy, strives to maintain order and civilization. Jack, responsible for the signal fire, becomes increasingly focused on hunting and power struggles. This leads to tensions within the group, gradually pushing the boys from hope and structure into chaos and tragedy.

metas.name: Love Always
metas.description: A heartfelt tale of rediscovery about life and an unexpected second chance at love.

metas.name: Lovesick
metas.description: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

metas.name: Lukkhe
metas.description: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

metas.name: Mad Concrete Dreams
metas.description: A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

metas.name: Made In India A Titan Story
metas.description: In a market ruled by smuggling and foreign brands, a determined Indian man Xerxes Desai, with the help of his team, dares to build a world-class watch from scratch. Battling rejection, failure, and global humiliation, they transform Titan into a symbol of national pride and innovation.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle
metas.description: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

metas.name: Man on Fire
metas.description: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

metas.name: Margao Files The Unsolved Case
metas.description: Doctors overrule foul play on the mysterious death of Richard White, patriarch of Margao's wealthy family. Yet Richard's family harbors deep suspicions after his will reveals unsettling secrets.

metas.name: Margos Got Money Troubles
metas.description: The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

metas.name: Marshals
metas.description: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.

metas.name: Matargashti
metas.description: Dhara's plan to explore her sexuality puts her at odds with her horrified father, who becomes determined to sabotage her love life.

metas.name: Matka King
metas.description: In this fictional tale set in 1960s Mumbai, an enterprising cotton trader who craves legitimacy and respect, starts a new gambling game dubbed ‘Matka’, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

metas.name: Meet the Owens
metas.description: Forget everything you think you know about Michael Owen. This is an action-packed and unexpectedly hilarious year in the life of the footballer-turned-Horse-Racing-Stable-owner & his famous family. Michael juggles a business on the edge with a chaotic home life, while daughter Gemma swaps social media for the saddle to become a jockey. Funny, warm… and far from boring.

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

metas.name: Minerva Academy
metas.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

metas.name: Monster The Lizzie Borden Story
metas.description: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: Murder in Galicia
metas.description: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

metas.name: Musafir Cafe
metas.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

metas.name: Muthassi
metas.description: In a remote village haunted by ancient secrets, a mother's love is put to the ultimate test when her son becomes entangled in a terrifying supernatural curse.

metas.name: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
metas.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

metas.name: My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

metas.name: My Brilliant Career
metas.description: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

metas.name: Nemesis
metas.description: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

metas.name: Not a Stranger
metas.description: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

metas.name: Not Suitable for Work
metas.description: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.

metas.name: Obsess
metas.description: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.

metas.name: Operation Safed Sagar
metas.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

metas.name: Our Sticky Love
metas.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

metas.name: Our Universe
metas.description: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

metas.name: Perfect Crown
metas.description: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

metas.name: Phantom Lawyer
metas.description: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

metas.name: Phoolsajya
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Politricks
metas.description: Betrayed by politics and drowning in debt, a beloved businessman and social worker fakes his own death for survival. But some secrets refuse to stay buried.

metas.name: Pompeii Out Of Time With Tom Hiddleston
metas.description: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

metas.name: Ponies
metas.description: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.

metas.name: Prem Shots
metas.description: A commitment-wary café owner and an independent graphic designer who walked out of an arranged marriage find their unexpected connection tested as shadows and unresolved baggage from their past relationships catch up with them.

metas.name: Prisoner
metas.description: A young and ambitious prison officer finds herself in the middle of a battle for the criminal underworld as crime lords try to evade justice. But in order to do that, she will have to learn quickly to put her faith in one of the very men she wants to put behind bars.

metas.name: Pritam and Pedro
metas.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

metas.name: Psycho Saiyaan
metas.description: Kartik Pandey, a poetic student in Ujjain, becomes obsessed with Charu, convinced she is his destiny. When she disappears, he learns she’s trapped by ruthless gangster-politician Huntry Chauhan. Infiltrating Huntry’s haveli, Kartik enters a violent world of manipulation where love turns toxic, obsession deepens, and sanity blurs into madness.

metas.name: Queens
metas.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

metas.name: Raakh
metas.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

metas.name: Reborn Rookie
metas.description: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

metas.name: Roktofolok
metas.description: As a thousand-year-old curse resurfaces in modern Bengal, tantric investigator Krishnananda Agambagish races against time to confront a reborn evil and uncover a prophecy rooted in forbidden rituals and divine wrath.

metas.name: Salvador
metas.description: During a violent confrontation arranged between radical fans of two football clubs, Salvador Aguirre, an ambulance driver, rescues his injured daughter Milena, a member of the ultra group, which defends racist, violent and homophobic values, totally opposed to those he instilled in her.

metas.name: Sangamarmar
metas.description: Amrita sacrifices her budding romance with Aditya to fulfill family responsibilities. Their tender love endures through years of separation, becoming a poignant tale of sacrifice, silent strength, and unchanging devotion.

metas.name: Sankalp
metas.description: SANKALP is a premium Indian socio-political drama that explores how power is manufactured not through elections, but through mentorship and institutional control. Inspired by the ancient Chanakya–Chandragupta chronicles, the series reimagines political strategy for modern India, where classrooms replace battlefields and bureaucrats replace soldiers.

metas.name: Santita
metas.description: Left in a wheelchair after a crash, Santita leaves the love of her life at the altar. Twenty years later, he returns with a request that changes everything.

metas.name: Satrangi Badle Ka Khe
metas.description: Witness the tale of Bablu, who is forced into Launda Naach, just like his murdered father. To what lengths will he go to avenge the wrongs that the powerful Singhs have bestowed on him and his family?

metas.name: Scarpetta
metas.description: Renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Kay Scarpetta returns to her position as Virginia's Chief Medical Examiner, where she investigates a haunting murder with eerie reminders from her first big case decades ago. In 1998, Scarpetta works alongside Detective Pete Marino and FBI Agent Benton Wesley as they investigate a series of brutal stranglings. Based on the best-selling novels by Patricia Cornwell.

metas.name: Shakha Proshakha
metas.description: Drowning in debt while trying to save her critically ill daughter, Nandita's last hope is her in-laws' property. A letter reveals a dark blood secret, shattering the family. Amid lies and manipulation, she searches for the truth. Will it break her, or set her free?

metas.name: Shaque Trust No One
metas.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

metas.name: Sins of Kujo
metas.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.

metas.name: something very bad to be happen
metas.description: Folder: English

metas.name: Space Gen Chandrayaan
metas.description: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

metas.name: Spider Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, an aging and down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: Spooky in Love
metas.description: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

metas.name: Spring Fever
metas.description: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

metas.name: Star Trek Starfleet Academy
metas.description: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

metas.name: Star Wars Maul Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: Steal
metas.description: A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.

metas.name: Straight to Hell
metas.description: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?

metas.name: Stranger Things Tales From 85
metas.description: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

metas.name: Student of the Year 3
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Super Subbu
metas.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

metas.name: Swargarath Sargaram
metas.description: Balahari, a middle-aged driver who lost his job during the lockdown, buys a third-hand hearse after selling his wife’s jewellery. The first funeral van in his village, it divides opinions—some see it as a bad omen, others as progress. His struggle to earn a living creates a touching, humorous rural tale.

metas.name: Taarkata
metas.description: A former police officer returns to his hometown to probe a puzzling death connected to his history.

metas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

metas.name: Taskaree The Smugglers Web
metas.description: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

metas.name: Teach You a Lesson
metas.description: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

metas.name: That Night
metas.description: When a young, naïve single mother gets embroiled in a murder during an island getaway, her sisters rush to help. But they only make things worse.

metas.name: The Apartment Job
metas.description: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

metas.name: The Art of Sarah
metas.description: A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?

metas.name: The Beauty
metas.description: The world of high fashion turns dark when international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways. FBI Agents Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett are sent to Paris to uncover the truth. As they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a sexually transmitted virus that transforms ordinary people into visions of physical perfection, but with terrifying consequences.

metas.name: The Blame
metas.description: Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

metas.name: The Burbs
metas.description: Set in present-day suburbia, a young couple returns to the husband's childhood home. Their world is upended when new neighbors move in across the street, bringing old secrets of the cul-de-sac to light, and new deadly threats shatter the illusion of their quiet little neighborhood.

metas.name: The Dinosaurs
metas.description: From the first dinosaurs to the last, this epic documentary series examines their 165 million years on Earth and the forces that shaped their evolution.

metas.name: The Doll
metas.description: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

metas.name: The East Palace
metas.description: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

metas.name: The Faithful
metas.description: This event series is told through the eyes of the courageous and passionate, yet flawed women whose descendants would shape three of the world's great faiths: Judaism, Christianity and Islam.

metas.name: The Fall of El Mayo
metas.description: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

metas.name: The Final Problem
metas.description: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

metas.name: The Fixers
metas.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

metas.name: The Good Daughter
metas.description: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

metas.name: The Greatest
metas.description: Fresh off gold at the 1960 Olympics, young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) sets his sights on the Heavyweight Championship. Contending with newfound fame, self-doubt, family conflict and a politically charged America, the once-in-a-generation prodigy discovers his greatest opponent won't be in the ring, but in a society that isn't ready for him to become his own man.

metas.name: The Judge Returns
metas.description: The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

metas.name: The Legend of Karna
metas.description: A warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer’s household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever.

metas.name: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier (Chwisabyeong Jeonseori Doeda)
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

metas.name: The Pyramid Scheme
metas.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

metas.name: The Revolutionaries
metas.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

metas.name: The Scandal
metas.description: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.
